reviews.title: My notes keep on getting deleted
reviews.text:
Absolutely disgraceful app. Apple Notes just deleted HOURS of handwritten annotations and work from my PDF the night before my exam. Entire pages of writing completely gone for no reason. I trusted this app with important study material and it failed at the worst possible time.

I spent hours making notes, highlighting, and annotating PDFs only for everything to suddenly disappear. No warning, no recovery, nothing. For a company that acts “premium,” losing users’ work like this is unacceptable.

Now I’m stuck redoing everything the day before an exam because Apple can’t make a basic notes app reliable. This is beyond frustrating — it’s careless. People use this app for school, work, and important documents, and clearly Apple doesn’t care enough to make sure data is actually safe.

Worst experience I’ve ever had with a note-taking app. Completely unreliable. I will never trust Apple Notes with anything important again.

reviews.title: Very Glitchy
reviews.text:
There are some very frustrating things that I hope the developers will see and improve:

BUG: When scrolling large notes (maybe 1,000 lines or more), the scroll is unbearably laggy and skippy.  After the scrolling is complete and you start editing in that location it will sometimes randomly place you somewhere else for the editing!  Significant bug. 

BUG: Similar to above: when searching for text in the note and going to that found text, it will sometimes place you at a random location!  Again, a significant bug since it results in editing text that you did not intend to edit and you can lose information this way.

BUG: When selecting a block of text (eg adjacent lines not separated by blank lines), sometimes the selection block highlights the block above, not the intended block. 

FEATURE: A true pure-plaintext mode (or separate plaintext app from Apple) would be appreciated.  There is "monospace" formatting but...that's just formatting.  A true plaintext mode like Textastic, etc. would be absolutely awesome.  I use notes to store numbers that look like phone numbers but they're not, so Notes automatically applies formatting and converts them to links even though that is not my intent.  The auto formatting is highly frustrating because you have to "trick" it with spaces or other punctuation to avoid auto formatting.  A "plaintext mode" is needed: no auto formatting, no checklists, no styling, no grids, no pictures, etc...simply true, 100% plaintext please!

reviews.title: Auto Calculate Makes Us Dumb!
reviews.text:
An annoying new auto calculate AI-powered functionality has been added to the app in the last few days. Just like predictive text, it predicts the answer to mathematical questions. So if you type ‘1+1=‘ in your notes (and indeed even in this review box I’m typing now, I just discovered!) then it gives you the answer ‘2’ by default. 

Not only is it not possible to permanently turn off this function (you can only turn it off for each individual note, but not the whole Notes app), but it’s forced on you, dumbing you down, in cases where you want to use the app for educational purposes, for example. 

My son has this Notes app on his iPad and uses it as part of working out answers to his maths homework. What’s the point of using the notes, or indeed his iPad to do his homework, now that the AI will do the homework for him???!!! And the fact that I can’t turn it off permanently, is simply intrusive, counter-productive and annoying. 

Lastly, there are times where I need to type an = sign or an equation to explain something to someone (like I did above). The auto calculate function will by default type the answer and won’t let me delete the answer no matter how hard I tried!!! The only workaround is to put quotation marks or something similar around it to indicate to the AI that this isn’t a maths problem to which it must give me an answer by brute force. 

What a stupid functionality that makes people stupid. Whose bright idea was this, and why am I not given the choice to turn i

reviews.title: Samsung was better
reviews.text: So I got a IPhone 17 pro and this is my first apple product ever. I had Samsung for so long and I enjoyed it but I decided to switch to Apple because my girlfriend has all of her stuff through Apple and thought it was a good idea to do it. I was able to transfer mostly everything over except for my notes on my Samsung. No big deal since I could just type it up in the Notes app. So I retyped all my notes in the Notes app from my Samsung notes, spending a solid 2 hours doing so. I then factory reset my Samsung so I could turn it in for the trade in deal. Btw, I didn’t have iCloud set up bc I did not know what that was yet and didn’t think I needed it for the notes app bc I assumed my notes would still save on the device. I WAS WRONG. After a day, I suddenly didn’t have access to my notes I spent 2 hours putting in on the Notes app. I’ve spent over an hour trying to find out how to get them back to basically learn it was my fault bc I didn’t have iCloud synced. I regret making the switch as I have now lost so much information from those notes being erased.
